summary: RC4-packed Windows PE dropper/loader with geo-fencing, privilege escalation, and encrypted payload. The binary imports only 7 APIs including SystemFunction033 (undocumented RC4 encryption/decryption) and ZwAdjustPrivilegesToken (privilege manipulation). The .text section is ~479KB with very high entropy (202), containing 19 large high-entropy buffers with no cross-references — consistent with a RC4-encrypted payload. Language detection APIs (GetUserDefaultLangID, GetSystemDefaultLCID, GetUserDefaultUILanguage) implement geo-fencing, likely to avoid execution on CIS/Russian systems. Capa confirms RC4 encryption via SystemFunction033 and System Language Discovery (T1614.001). YARA matches IsPacked and IsWindowsGUI. FLOSS extracted 1144 static strings but zero decoded/stack strings — all non-import content is encrypted. The entry function spans nearly the entire .text section, acting as a decryptor stub.
key_evidence: capa: 'encrypt data using RC4 via SystemFunction033' — Defense Evasion/T1027, MBC C0027.009
capa: 'identify system language via API' — Discovery/T1614.001 (geo-fencing evasion)
Import: SystemFunction033 (ADVAPI32.DLL) — undocumented RC4 encryption API, used to decrypt payload at runtime
Import: ZwAdjustPrivilegesToken (NTDLL.DLL) — undocumented privilege escalation API
Import: FreeEncryptedFileKeyInfo (ADVAPI32.DLL) — EFS encryption key management
YARA: IsPacked match — binary is packed/encrypted
Malcat anomaly: BigBufferNoXrefMediumToHighEntropy x19 — 19 large crypto data blocks with no cross-references
Malcat: .text section entropy=202, overall entropy=201 — extremely high entropy indicates encrypted content
Ghidra: entry function spans 0x401000-0x4664844 (~466KB), cyclomatic complexity=102, 101 outgoing calls — massive decryptor stub
Strings: 1144 static strings but only import names readable; all others are obfuscated/encoded (e.g. repeating '=?a\x1b' patterns)
FLOSS: 0 decoded strings, 0 stack strings, 0 language strings — entire payload remains encrypted at rest
Ghidra xrefs: COMPUTED_JUMP to all imports — indirect/dynamic import resolution (IAT obfuscation)
User locale APIs (GetUserDefaultLangID, GetSystemDefaultLCID, GetUserDefaultUILanguage) — CIS geo-fencing pattern common in ransomware
